display.summary: The maintenance page moves out of the project and into the Composer image.
highlights: New projects no longer carry .proxy/maintenance.html: composer-agent publishes the page on the runtime volume and the proxy serves it (stack schema 3, needs Composer 1.7.0b1+).
Existing stacks keep working; 'composer check --fix' migrates them and keeps a customised page as the .proxy/maintenance/ override.
